normalization: OpenCC TSCharacters.txt (Apache-2.0) maps traditional to simplified for normalized_text; original_text keeps the source characters.
sourceNote: The three repos are public-domain EPUB editions; 后汉书 README says it is based on 漢川草廬. The corpus is not bundled in the installer; it is imported into the user's local database.
limits: Only three works are imported. Search uses 4-character overlap plus an exact-match bonus, not a real full-text index. Traditional and simplified variants are normalized, but rare variant characters can still miss.
